item.title: Ten Feet of Nothing Blood
item.description: We bring you good tidings! There might be an Israel-Hamas ceasefire agreement, and George Santos is being freed from political persecution in an American hoosegow.

item.title: Reading Fanon’s Psychiatric Papers
item.description: I never once encountered Frantz Fanon on the page in my nine years of Canadian medical training. He is not in the medical curriculum at all.

item.title: This Zohran Could Be Your Life
item.description: Today we bid adieu to Georgia Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, the Crossfit psycho who bewitched America with her homemade stew of Qanon zingers and blood libel.

item.title: Monumental Ephemera: Labor in Mid-Century Mexican Postcards
item.description: Mexico, our monumental neighbor to the south, blessed with a rich indigenous culture and a deep relationship with the arts, is also, somewhat paradoxically, a perfect locale to capture, reproduce, and share via postcard ephemera.

item.title: My Historical Guide to Guides
item.description: There are many different types of guides at historical sites, and I wanted to be at least one of them.

item.title: Until the Bend of the World
item.description: It has been quite a while now, but a jaded critic once referred to our site as The Bleep Bloop Review. We credit you!

item.title: When Did Everything Become Terrorism?
item.description: Historians Lily Pearl Balloffet and Cinthya Martinez look at the way actual terrorists like Trump and ICE have expanded the definition of terrorism to include everyone they don't like.

item.title: The Silence: A Requisite for Campaigns of Anti-Kurdish Violence and Genocide
item.description: In their haste to embrace the new Syrian regime, the international community has yet again shunted the Kurdish people aside. It must stop.

item.title: If Only It Could Be 1979 and Rhodesia Was Still a Thing
item.description: We live in a time of hopes and horrors and mirrors. Just enough funhouse distortion to make everything un-understandable.

item.title: (Im)Possible White Failure and Its Draw: Donald Trump, MAGA, and Eventual Death
item.description: Donald Trump is a failure. Donald Trump fails at almost everything. He fails at everything. But this failure is powerful. This failure is successful.
